publisher: National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA), Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
structure_note: Verified against the official NCA CSCC-1:2019 document (English and Arabic PDFs): 4 main domains, 21 subdomains, 32 main controls and 73 subcontrols. This catalog enumerates the 32 x-y-z main controls; the deeper x-y-z-w items are subcontrol clauses summarized inside each control's intent. CSCC control IDs follow the SAME domain-subdomain-control (x-y-z) scheme as ECC (main domain / subdomain / main control / subcontrol). CSCC is an ADD-ON to ECC: nearly every main control is phrased as 'in addition to' a specific ECC control/subdomain (referenced in each intent), so critical systems must first meet ECC then layer these stricter controls. CSCC has no ICS domain of its own (ECC domain 5); instead its 4 domains re-cover Governance, Defense, Resilience, and Third-Party/Cloud with critical-system-specific requirements. Like ECC, controls carry no per-control title in either language (title_en is a short paraphrase; title_ar is left "" and Arabic is carried at subdomain level). All 4 domain Arabic titles and all 21 subdomain Arabic titles were confirmed directly against the official CSCC Arabic PDF.

domains.title_ar: الأمن السيبراني المتعلق بالأطراف الخارجية والحوسبة السحابية

controls.title_en: Prioritize critical-systems protection in the cybersecurity strategy
controls.intent: In addition to ECC subdomain 1-1, the organization's cybersecurity strategy must explicitly prioritize supporting the protection of its critical systems.

controls.title_en: Critical-systems risk assessment and register
controls.intent: Extending ECC subdomain 1-5, the risk-management methodology must include at least an annual cybersecurity risk assessment of critical systems and a risk register reviewed at least monthly.

controls.subdomain_en: Cybersecurity in Information Technology Project Management
controls.subdomain_ar: الأمن السيبراني ضمن إدارة المشاريع المعلوماتية والتقنية
controls.title_en: Critical-systems project and change management
controls.intent: Extending ECC control 1-6-2, cybersecurity for critical-systems project and asset-change management must include stress-testing component capacity and ensuring business-continuity requirements are met.

controls.subdomain_en: Cybersecurity in Information Technology Project Management
controls.subdomain_ar: الأمن السيبراني ضمن إدارة المشاريع المعلوماتية والتقنية
controls.title_en: Secure software development for critical systems
controls.intent: Extending ECC control 1-6-3, critical-systems development must include pre-release source-code review, secured source-code access/storage/documentation, secured authenticated APIs, and secure test-to-production migration with deletion of test data and credentials.

controls.title_en: Annual internal review of CSCC implementation
controls.intent: Referencing ECC control 1-8-1, the cybersecurity function must review the organization's implementation of CSCC at least once annually.

controls.title_en: Independent review of CSCC implementation
controls.intent: Referencing ECC control 1-8-2, CSCC implementation must be reviewed by parties independent of the cybersecurity function, inside the organization, at least once every three years.

controls.title_en: Pre-employment vetting and Saudi staffing for critical systems
controls.intent: Extending ECC control 1-9-3, pre-employment requirements must include screening/vetting candidates who will work on critical systems, and filling technical support and development positions with experienced Saudi professionals.

controls.title_en: Critical-systems asset inventory and ownership
controls.intent: Extending ECC subdomain 2-1, asset management must include an annually-updated inventory of critical-systems assets and identifying asset owners and involving them across the critical-systems asset lifecycle.

controls.title_en: Hardened IAM for critical systems (no foreign remote access, MFA, DB access controls)
controls.intent: Extending ECC 2-2-3 for critical systems: block remote access from outside KSA and restrict/monitor it inside; MFA for all and privileged users; strong password and secure-hashing policy; managed service accounts with no interactive login; database access only via applications.

controls.title_en: Quarterly review of critical-systems access rights
controls.intent: Referencing ECC subcontrol 2-2-3-5, user identities and access rights to critical systems must be reviewed at least once every three months.

controls.subdomain_en: Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
controls.title_en: Hardened host protection for critical-systems servers
controls.intent: Extending ECC 2-3-3 for critical systems: application whitelisting, approved endpoint protection, monthly/quarterly patching, an isolated privileged-management network, encrypted non-console admin access, six-monthly hardening reviews, removal of default/backdoor passwords, and protection of logs and critical files.

controls.title_en: Critical-systems network isolation and defense
controls.intent: Extending ECC 2-5-3 for critical systems: logically and physically segregate critical networks, review firewall rules six-monthly, prohibit wireless, add network-layer APT and DDoS protection, block internet access for internal systems, and enforce firewall whitelisting only.

controls.title_en: Restrict mobile access to critical systems
controls.intent: Extending ECC control 2-6-3: prohibit mobile-device access to critical systems except temporarily after a risk assessment and cybersecurity-function approval, and apply full-disk encryption to any mobile device with access to critical systems.

controls.title_en: Critical-systems data protection and non-production controls
controls.intent: Extending ECC control 2-7-3: prohibit using critical-systems data outside production unless strictly controlled (e.g. masking/scrambling); classify all critical-systems data; apply data-leakage prevention; define retention keeping only required data in production; and prohibit transferring production data to any other environment.

controls.title_en: Encrypt critical-systems data in-transit and at-rest
controls.intent: Extending ECC control 2-8-3: encrypt all critical-systems data in-transit, and at-rest at file, database or column level, using current secure methods, algorithms, keys and devices in line with NCA guidance.

controls.title_en: Critical-systems backup scope and protection
controls.intent: Extending ECC control 2-9-3: online and offline backups must cover all critical systems, run at risk-based intervals (NCA recommends daily), with secured access, storage and transfer of backups and media protected against destruction, unauthorized access or modification.

controls.title_en: Quarterly backup recovery testing
controls.intent: Referencing ECC subcontrol 2-9-3-3, a test must be conducted at least once every three months to determine the efficiency of recovering critical-systems backups.

controls.title_en: Critical-systems vulnerability assessment and remediation cadence
controls.intent: Extending ECC control 2-10-3: use trusted assessment methods/tools; remediate vulnerabilities via security updates at least monthly (external/internet-connected) or quarterly (internal); and immediately remediate critical vulnerabilities per approved change management.

controls.title_en: Monthly vulnerability assessments of critical systems
controls.intent: Referencing ECC subcontrol 2-10-3-1, vulnerability assessments must be conducted on critical-systems technical components at least once every month.

controls.title_en: Critical-systems penetration test scope and team
controls.intent: Extending ECC control 2-11-3: penetration-test scope must cover all critical-systems technical components and their internal and external services, and tests must be conducted by a qualified team.

controls.title_en: Six-monthly penetration testing of critical systems
controls.intent: Referencing ECC subcontrol 2-11-3-2, penetration tests must be conducted on critical systems at least once every six months.

controls.subdomain_en: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
controls.subdomain_ar: إدارة سجلات الأحداث ومراقبة الأمن السيبراني
controls.title_en: 24/7 logging and monitoring of critical systems
controls.intent: Extending ECC control 2-12-3: enable event logs on all critical-systems technical components; activate and monitor file-integrity alerts/logs; monitor and analyze user behavior; monitor critical-systems security events around the clock; and retain and protect logs with full details.

controls.subdomain_en: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
controls.subdomain_ar: إدارة سجلات الأحداث ومراقبة الأمن السيبراني
controls.title_en: 18-month log retention for critical systems
controls.intent: Referencing ECC subcontrol 2-12-3-5, cybersecurity event logs for critical systems must be retained for a minimum of 18 months per relevant legal and regulatory requirements.

controls.title_en: Secure sessions and OWASP for critical-systems web apps
controls.intent: Extending ECC control 2-15-3, external web applications for critical systems must include secure session management (session authenticity, lockout and timeout) and apply at least the OWASP Top Ten minimum standards.

controls.title_en: Minimum three-tier architecture for web apps
controls.intent: Referencing ECC subcontrol 2-15-3-2, a multi-tier architecture of at least three tiers must be used for critical-systems web applications.

controls.title_en: Define internal-application cybersecurity requirements
controls.intent: Cybersecurity requirements for critical systems' internal applications must be defined, documented and approved.

controls.title_en: Implement internal-application cybersecurity requirements
controls.intent: The defined cybersecurity requirements for critical systems' internal applications must be implemented.

controls.title_en: Core internal-application control set
controls.intent: Internal-application requirements must include at least multi-tier architecture (no fewer than three tiers), secure protocols (e.g. HTTPS), a defined acceptable-use policy for users, and secure session management (authenticity, lockout, timeout).

controls.title_en: Periodically review internal-application requirements
controls.intent: Cybersecurity requirements for critical systems' internal applications must be reviewed periodically.

controls.subdomain_en: Cybersecurity Resilience Aspects of Business Continuity Management (BCM)
controls.subdomain_ar: جوانب صمود الأمن السيبراني في إدارة استمرارية الأعمال
controls.title_en: Disaster recovery for critical systems
controls.intent: Extending ECC control 3-1-3, business-continuity requirements must include establishing a disaster-recovery center for critical systems, incorporating critical systems in DR plans, and testing DR plans at least annually (NCA recommends periodic live DR tests).

controls.title_en: Vet third parties and require Saudi providers for critical systems
controls.intent: Extending ECC subdomain 4-1, third-party contracts and agreements must include screening/vetting of outsourcing and managed-services companies and personnel working on critical systems, and require reliance on Saudi companies per relevant regulatory requirements.

controls.subdomain_ar: الأمن السيبراني المتعلق بالحوسبة السحابية والاستضافة
controls.title_en: In-Kingdom, CCC-compliant hosting of critical systems
controls.intent: Extending ECC control 4-2-3, hosting of critical systems and any of their technical components must be inside the organization or via cloud services provided by government or Saudi companies compliant with NCA's Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CCC), accounting for hosted-data classification.
